text:
perf-bot: nightly perf alert: model-serving.p95 +22% vs baseline (was 345ms -> now 420ms), throughput -8%. Alert window started ~2026-03-17T03:00Z. Route: /v1/generate. Tags: kernel=auto, seq_len<=64.

Amanda C: saw the alert on dashboards, p95 spike aligns with a merge around 02:44 UTC. pinging @Raj P and @Santiago M to start triage.

Raj P: starting quick bisect over merges in last 12h. candidates: PR#2456 (kernel selector refactor), PR#2459 (batcher tweak), PR#2461 (infra: threadpool). Will run perf_bisect script.

Santiago M: fyi I noticed weird kernel-selection counts in staging earlier today. attaching profiler snippet from staging run at 03:10Z:

```
kernel_selector_histogram (now):
  fast_small: 62%
  polymorph_slow: 28%
  fallback_unopt: 10%

kernel_selector_histogram (baseline yesterday):
  fast_small: 85%
  polymorph_slow: 5%
```

Santiago M: that weight shift would explain ~15-25% p95 regression for short sequences. also KV eviction rate jumped concurrently.

Raj P: kv metrics: kv.evictions_per_min ~4.2 -> 12.1 during spike window. could be selector -> cache mismatch causing hotset churn.

Lisa K: kicking off CI perf-bisect: `./ci/perf_bisect --range=main~6..main --metric=p95 --target=model-inference --parallel 4`. job id ci-job-9921.

perf-bot: perf-bisect job started (ci-job-9921). collecting runs...

Raj P: quick update from local bisect run: reverting PR#2456 on staging returns kernel histogram to baseline and p95 back to ~340ms. PR#2459 and #2461 look clean.

Santiago M: patched canary with a short-term override: `selector.force_prefer=fast_small when seq_len < 64`. canary at 20% traffic now.

Amanda C: canary results after 10m: p95 dropped to 335ms on canary nodes, overall cluster p95 down ~12% since canary. holding rollout.

Lisa K: opened revert PR 2465 that reverts 2456 and adds a regression test for selector weight decay. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/2465

Raj P: proposed action: revert immediately to stop SLO breach, then investigate root cause in 2456 (weight normalization bug + unintended side-effect on policy for short sequences). also add unit tests and a KV eviction sim to CI.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback scheduled at 2026-03-18T04:15:00Z (job 12458). Revert PR 2465 queued for deploy.

Amanda C: filed incident IN-4832, set severity to S2 (SLO impact). Notifying CS and oncall.

Santiago M: full perf profile uploaded: flamegraph https://ci.redwood.example/reports/fg-5371000000.svg. profile shows extra cycles in polymorph_slow kernel hotpath.

perf-bot: ci-job-9921 finished. bisect result: culprit PR#2456. rollback candidate PR#2465 passed e2e perf, p95 back to 330-340ms in canary.

Lisa K: merging revert now after approvals. follow-up ticket created: TKT-8794 (investigate selector refactor + add selector metrics + unit tests).

Raj P: long-term follow-ups: 1) add canary gating for kernel-selection distribution diffs; 2) extend nightly perf checks to include kernel histogram alerts; 3) evaluate whether selector should consult KV hotset signals to avoid eviction cascades.

Amanda C: thanks all — rolling revert to stop the regression. after rollback we will run a controlled re-roll of PR#2456 with more telemetry and a safety flag. closing triage for now, moving to post-mortem.

deploy-bot: Revert PR merged and deployed to canary at 2026-03-18T04:17:23Z. Production rollout scheduled once canary stable for 30m.

Amanda C: marking this thread for postmortem. I'll start draft and assign owners.
